not_enabled.reason: OSV already aggregates GitHub Security Advisories and GitHub capability exists separately; duplicate runtime omitted.
deps.dev provides Maven package, version and dependency metadata without dynamic service discovery; native multi-step protocol omitted.
NuGet metadata requires service-index discovery and can require additional requests; deps.dev is used under the one-request rule.
deps.dev provides Go module metadata and requirements; native text endpoints add little normalized value.
Free-key service overlaps deps.dev and native registries; no unique production requirement established.
Broad community aggregator overlaps deps.dev, OSV and native registries; retained as future resilience candidate.
POST harvest and curation mutate upstream state and are prohibited.
Archival, vault cooking and deposit operations are writes or asynchronous multi-request workflows and are prohibited.
ISO, IEC, IEEE and other paid standards full text cannot be exposed without a license.
